notes: Two routes from «عبد الرزاق»: Ahmad's («قال أحمد حدثنا معمر») and Hasan's («وقال الحسن»); no «ح», so each is written in full and the tail is null
The Ahmad route is read only to «أشعث»: the continuation «عن الحسن، عن عبد الله بن مغفل» is written once, inside the Hasan route, and is not copied into Ahmad's
«ثم يتوضأ فيه» is Ahmad's wording variant: left out
